TaskItem.title: TaskItem
TaskItem.description: A user-owned task with optional due date, reminder timestamp, repetition schedule, color accent, and embedded subtasks.

userId.description: Authenticated owner Firebase UID matching the parent users/{userId} path.

notes.description: Optional additional task notes (0 to 500 characters).

completed.description: Whether the task is currently marked complete.

colorKey.description: Vibrant color accent token assigned to the task.

dueDateMillis.description: Optional due date stored as UTC epoch milliseconds (> 0). Omitted when unset.

reminderMillis.description: Optional reminder trigger time stored as UTC epoch milliseconds (> 0). Omitted when unset.

repeatRule.description: Repetition cadence applied when completing the task.

repeatInterval.description: Positive repetition multiplier (1 to 365) paired with repeatRule.

subtasks.description: Bounded list (max 30) of embedded subtask objects with id, title, and done boolean.

createdAt.description: Immutable creation timestamp written via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

updatedAt.description: Last modification timestamp written via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

/users/{userId}/tasks/{taskId}.description: User-isolated subcollection storing all tasks owned by the authenticated user.
